server.name: io.github.chrischall/freshbooks-mcp
server.description: FreshBooks invoicing for Claude — invoices, clients, estimates, and payments

environmentVariables.description: OAuth client ID from my.freshbooks.com/#/developer
environmentVariables.name: FRESHBOOKS_CLIENT_ID

environmentVariables.description: OAuth client secret
environmentVariables.name: FRESHBOOKS_CLIENT_SECRET

environmentVariables.description: OAuth refresh token from the one-time bootstrap (rotates on every use)

environmentVariables.description: Registered redirect URI; required on refresh calls too (default https://localhost/callback)
environmentVariables.name: FRESHBOOKS_REDIRECT_URI

environmentVariables.description: Path for the rotating-refresh-token store (default ~/.freshbooks-mcp/session.json)
environmentVariables.name: FRESHBOOKS_TOKEN_STORE
